fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Given a returning customer with a previously used payment method, when checkout loads, then their last used method is pre-selected.

Given a pre-selected method, when the customer confirms the order, then payment is charged with that method without a separate selection step.

Given a customer whose last used method is no longer available, when checkout loads, then no method is pre-selected and a message explains why.
fields.System.Description:
Context: Checkout currently shows all available payment methods with no default; returning customers re-pick their method on every order. The one-page checkout redesign under this feature aims to remove checkout steps.

Reason: Funnel analytics: returning customers spend a median 11 seconds selecting a payment method they used on their previous order; UX research flagged method selection as the top friction point for returning customers. Marketing asked for a "one-tap pay" experience.

Scope: Web checkout for signed-in returning customers. Out of scope: guest checkout, native apps, adding new payment methods.
fields.System.Title: Auto-select last used payment method at checkout
